theorems.statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn m)) (φ : Rn m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (v₀ : Rn m), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 φ V → v₀ ∈ V → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ φ v₀) → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ closedBall v₀ δ ⊆ V ∧ ∀ w : Rn m, ‖w‖ ≤ δ → c * ‖w‖ ≤ ‖φ (v₀ + w) - φ v₀‖
